cards.answer: Taric is a support tank who alternates spells with empowered attacks that deal bonus magic damage and refresh his basic abilities faster. His healing benefits from health, while his empowered attacks and stun damage benefit from armor.
cards.counterplay: Limit his access to melee attacks, dodge his delayed stun, and hold burst while his team is invulnerable.

cards.answer: Bastion grants Taric bonus armor and shares that bonus with his linked ally while the tether persists. Its activation shields Taric and the targeted ally, binding that ally to him. Taric's abilities also cast from the linked ally while the tether persists.
cards.counterplay: Account for spells coming from the linked ally and look for pressure when the pair separate.
